sources: live engine probe of every internal device (composerbench devices refresh, MAGDA ebd93db0 + serve patch, Linux)

4osc.summary: Tracktion FourOsc: 4 oscillators with unison detune/spread, filter, envelopes, built-in FX.

Surge XT.summary: Hosted Surge XT synth (VST3). Big unison supersaws.

params.name: A Filter 1 Type
params.note: 0.005 Off (init patch), 0.03 LP 12 dB, 0.05 LP 24 dB

Surge XT.notes: Hosted VST3. Parameters are normalised 0..1 and many are not declared discrete. A Filter 1 Type 0.03 = 'LP 12 dB' (the init patch has the filter Off). Allow ~4 s after loading before setting parameters.

magda_bell.notes: Physical bell model; decay in ms.

magda_clap.summary: Synth clap: flammed noise bursts with tail.

magda_fm.summary: 4-operator FM synth with a full modulation matrix. Bells, keys, metallic leads, noise.
magda_fm.notes: M<src><dst> is the modulation amount from operator src into operator dst; Op1 is the carrier by default. Op Wave 'Noise' turns an operator into a noise source.

magda_hat.summary: Synth hi-hat: metallic ring partials + high-passed noise. Long decays make open hats/crashes.

magda_kick.summary: Synth kick: transient + pitched body + click. Short decay = punchy, long = 808 boom.

magda_polysynth.summary: 4-oscillator subtractive synth: sine/saw/square/triangle, multimode filter with envelope and velocity amount, mono/legato glide. Bass, leads, pads, plucks.
magda_polysynth.notes: Voice Mode 'Legato' + Glide (ms) slides between overlapping notes. Vel Filter (octaves) lets note velocity open the filter: the only way to sweep a filter without automation on protocol 2.

magda_snare.summary: Synth snare: transient, tuned body and filtered noise rattle.

magda_tom.summary: Synth tom with pitch bend; short and bent it makes zaps.

magda_bitcrusher.summary: Sample-rate and bit-depth reduction with drive and tone.

magda_compressor.summary: Compressor (Clean or Glue engine) with sidechain HPF and parallel mix.

magda_delay.summary: Stereo delay with tempo sync (Division) and ping-pong (Cross).

magda_dimension.summary: Stereo widener: Dimension, Haas or M/S.

magda_eq.notes: 8 bands. Enable a band with 'Band N Enabled' = 1 before its Type/Freq/Gain/Q matter.

magda_filter.summary: Multimode filter with six engine models and drive.
magda_filter.notes: Mode labels depend on Engine: SVF/Oberheim LP-BP-HP-Notch, Ladder LP-HP; set Engine before Mode.

magda_grain_delay.summary: Granular delay with pitch and spray.

magda_grit.summary: Adds noise/sine grit around a frequency.

magda_mod.summary: Tremolo / vibrato / autopan with tempo sync.
magda_mod.notes: Tempo-synced tremolo / vibrato / autopan: Sync On + Division + Shape Square gives a rhythmic gate.

magda_multiband.notes: OTT-style upward/downward multiband compressor (Low/Mid/High). Per-band parameters exist but are not catalogued yet: inspect them live.

magda_reverb.summary: Algorithmic reverb (Plate/Hall/Room) with predelay, damping and cut filters.

magda_utility.summary: Gain, pan, width, low-end mono, phase flips.
magda_utility.notes: Pan/Width/Low Mono live here: the CLI has no track pan, so pan with this.
